profile.headline: AI Technical Lead @ Funnel | Shaping engineering patterns for agentic systems
profile.jobTitle: Sr. Software Engineer, Technical Lead - AI
profile.summary:
I'm interested in building AI systems that hold up in production and evolve with the product.
 
Currently Technical Lead on Funnel's AI team, working on LLM orchestration, agentic workflows, and the backend patterns and data modeling underneath them. Previously: Lead Engineer at the Hispanic Scholarship Fund where I operationalized LLM systems on AWS Bedrock using event-driven messaging at scale, and Software Engineering Manager at Strateos where we built a cloud lab automation platform.
 
My path runs through synthetic biology research, cloud lab automation, and AI engineering leadership. I hold an M.S. in Computer Science from Georgia Tech and B.Sc. in Biology from Gonzaga. Publications in Nature Biotechnology and Synthetic Biology journals.

Always interested in conversations on AI infrastructure, cloud computing, scientific computing, and the work of turning research into shipped products.

positions.title: Lead Engineer, Engineering
positions.description:
Set and execute platform wide technical strategy across cloud infrastructure, backend, DevOps, and frontend. Architect scalable, cost efficient, event-driven systems that generate actionable analytics and reliably support hundreds of thousands of scholars and donors, translating organizational priorities into durable technical outcomes.

• Develop architectural POCs and conduct load tests to validate scalability under realistic traffic patterns.

• Document Verification (Production LLM System): Architected an AI guided verification pipeline using AWS Bedrock LLMs and Textract OCR to expedite processing of applicant materials while safeguarding PII. The system currently serves hundreds of thousands of scholars across thousands of institutions, handling diverse scholarship application documents.

• Broadcast-Center: Architected and delivered a highly scalable, event-driven messaging system enabling SMS/voice campaigns to 200k+ recipients per campaign, with real-time status tracking and fault-tolerant delivery.
• Built an analytics dashboard showing delivery and failure rates over 7/30/90-day windows, with visibility into scheduled campaigns for execution.
• Empowered users to adjust campaign strategies based on delivery insights, contributing to a reduction in Twilio reported message failure rates resulting in cost savings by lowering failure SMS/voice charges.

• Fund-A-Scholar (fund-a-scholar.hsf.net): Full-stack crowdfunding web app enabling donors to directly fund students.
• Integrated Stripe payments and implemented DB + Valkey locks to prevent overfunding and double-spend race conditions. Reduced refunding situations minimized operational overhead​.
positions.insights: Skills: Serverless Computing · Stripe (Software) · Microfrontends · AI Engineering · AWS Bedrock · Twilio

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Engineering cloud infrastructure and applications to automate and structure scientific experiments. 
Strateos enables organizations to capture their scientific intent and transform it into a deterministic machine readable schema that can be executed on the Strateos Cloud Lab Environment. Strateos provides a centralized UI for operators and researchers to plan, execute, and analyze their experimental workflows. It empowers our scientists to scale the throughput of their experiment, reduce hands on time, and generate data that feed into data pipelines and data driven applications.

- Remotely manage team in feature implementations and contribute to workflow engine distributed system. 
- Manage relationship between third party offshore development team to increase engineering resources to meet quarterly milestones.
- Performed frontend performance analysis and generated roadmap to decrease CPU and network consumption collaborated with product and design teams to incorporate tech debt into product roadmap. 
- Led initiative to streamline incident triaging processes, resulting in an increase in the engineer volunteering rate. Implemented process changes that improved team accountability for respective components. 
- Use Jira and Slack APIs and automation to improve developer velocity and accountability.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Processing Experimental Workflows at Remote Laboratories
- Scientific laboratory instrument edge device deployment & configuration
- Scientist centric graphical experimental workflow builder
- Led the design and development of enterprise level microservice applications in Workflows domain. Full-stack service applications used React, Python, Flask, Java, Springboot, and Postgres deployed onto EKS using ArgoCD.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Interfaced with scientific clients to plan and manage automated experimental executions on cloud controlled devices
- Track record of meeting client experimental needs and building robust, automated data pipelines
- Established a mammalian flow cytometry data generation pipeline with automated gaussian distribution gating analysis
- Curator of open-source machine readable scientific intent schemas, autoprotocol.org & autoprotocol-py

positions.title: Research Scientist/Engineer II
positions.description:
Part of the UW BIOFAB team in the Klavins Lab. Establishing reliable cellular and molecular protocols as executable code to develop data-driven methods, accelerate scientific discoveries, create robust synthetic biology designs, and establish data pipelines for the Synergistic Discovery and Design DARPA Program (SD2). 

Synthetic Biology
•	Investigating Boolean logic synthetic gene circuits in Yeast & E. coli. Developing an RNA Sequencing pipeline, created an automated Yeast Synthetic Circuit screening assay, & built an automated High Throughput Induction assay for the Klavins Lab.
•	Investigating yeast cell cycle gene activation and how to measure cell states in line with Yeast Circuit screen.

Programming
•	Automating high throughput assays through laboratory management software called, Aquarium (https://github.com/klavinslab/aquarium)
•	Using a relational database to associate and save scientific measurements, represent experiments virtually, & rapidly query and analyze data programmatically. Building python scripting tools to refine data pipeline.

Leadership & Managerial 
•	Interact with PIs, Research Scientists, Professors, Software Engineers, Data Scientist, & companies across the country. Present & discuss biological findings, how to best automate assays, and analyze large amounts of data.
•	Teach, guide, and advise undergraduate research assistants through cellular and molecular experiments.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Biochemistry · Statistical Data Analysis · Biotechnology · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Associate Scientist
positions.description: Collaborated with Reliance Industries to establish genetic and molecular tools for manipulating metabolic and photosynthetic pathways in cyanobacteria, in order to increase lipid content, growth, and produce highly valued metabolites.
positions.insights: Skills: Biochemistry · Cell Culture · PCR · Life Sciences · Biotechnology · Microbiology · Cell Biology

positions.title: Research Assistant to Dr. Rose Ann Cattolico
positions.locationName: University of Washington Biology Department, Seattle, WA
positions.description:
Participated in cellular growth and lipid studies of a unicellular alga, Chyrsochromulina tobin, for potential biofuel production. See Crowdfunding Campaign for Seattle Algae Biofuel Research Project below.

• Utilized flow cytometry, GC/MS, and other instrumentation to characterize cell cycle and analyze lipid composition throughout organism lifecycle.

• Developed high throughput method to quantify lipid content, in vivo, using BODIPY staining and flow cytometry.

• Investigated algal bacterial symbiotic cohorts by sequencing ribosomal subunit genes and developing a phylogenetic tree to relate the identified bacteria
positions.insights: Skills: Cell Culture · PCR · Life Sciences · Biotechnology · Microbiology · Cell Biology

positions.title: Leadership Team Member
positions.description: The Campus Kitchens Project is a national organization, a leader in community service for students, and is the future of hunger relief. It empowers the next generation to implement innovative models for combating hunger, develops food systems, and helps communities help themselves.  In Spokane, Gonzaga University Campus Kitchens would produce and serve meals to hundreds of people on a weekly basis. As a regular volunteer I assisted with the serving and delivering of meals. In addition, we wanted to not only provide someone with hot meal, but also provide accompaniment in order to allow people to decompress and enjoy the moment. Furthermore, while on the Leadership Team I helped plan and run fundraisers to raise money, and tried to incorporate and recruit the Gonzaga University student body as volunteers. In this role I developed the skills to organize and plan events, talk and coordinate with different levels of administration, and prioritize tasks by often delineating from standard weekly tasks

positions.title: Science In Action
positions.description: Led after-school science programs at Roosevelt Elementary in Spokane, WA. We made scientific phenomena fun and easy to understand for fourth and fifth graders. Each week we would coordinate with teachers to design experiments that coincided with current scientific themes in class.
